context:
You asked at 17:19 CST why so much of the roadmap stays undone. The largest single cause: about ten steps need your computer, and no session can reach it, because none of your folders is shared through Remote Control. They include the iPhone app checks on your Mac, a limit on how many app builds run at once, your local settings for when a session summarizes its context, reading your local safety log, checking which GitHub sign-in fails, cleaning up finished branches, turning off the old plugin that still runs on your PC, and updating Claude Code there. One share unblocks them all, and lets a session there do the acts you already allowed on Oct 30 (protect branches, delete merged branches, close replaced pull requests).
Why yours: only you can choose which folders a cloud session may use; the check of your shared folders found none (Nov 1 16:56 CST).
